item: A pin names any route that serves a logged diagnostics file without the cross-site guard; the count-deadline harness cleans up its store
summary: served_file_response appends to diagnostics/runs.jsonl, so every route that calls it must carry refuse_cross_site_get. An AST scan over src/ now fails BY NAME for a fourth such route before anyone plants a file for it (it also fails if it finds fewer than the three F3 routes, so it cannot go blind). Mutation-checked: stripping the guard from one route, and adding an unguarded caller, both fail it. The S3 count-deadline harness takes pytest's tmp_path instead of leaving a mkdtemp store of 40,000 rows in the system temp directory. Test-only, no src change.
